quote: In this architecture, 94% of the total operations are offloaded from the digital platform into the meta-optic, leading to a substantial speed up for classification tasks
notes: Measured accuracy 98.6% MNIST / 88.8% Fashion-MNIST. Still electronic: polarization-sensitive camera, optoelectronic subtraction for negative kernels, digital layers. No wall-plug energy reported. Tier next.

claim: Most optical NNs digitize natural light with a camera and re-encode it onto coherent light (photon->electron->photon), which the spectral CNN chip avoids
locator: Nat. Commun. 16, 81 (2025-01-02), Introduction (Europe PMC PMC11696300)
quote: broadband incoherent natural light is usually captured by digital cameras and then encoded to coherent light for optical computing (Fig. 1a ), which not only degrades the energy efficiency but also loses the light field features
notes: The optical layer is only the input + first convolutional layer; a reconfigurable electrical back end does the rest. System throughput is readout-limited (R3-032). Tier next.

claim: Passive incoherent diffractive network classifying under natural light, detector output = result (no electro-optic front end)
locator: Photonics 12(3):278 (2025-03-18), Abstract (text via Semantic Scholar API; MDPI blocks automated access)
quote: This model is completely passive and directly performs inference calculations on natural light, with the detector directly outputting the results
notes: Accuracy well below electronic baselines; no energy figure. Tier next (lab).
